name: The Mountain Pass & Eastern Ridge
act: Act II: The Watch on the Overhang & The Grey Wind's Bargain
description: Steep stepped strata of slate and alpine scree between 22-meter granite peaks. Factor Vane's cryo-servitors haul the stasis coffin up the eastern saddle while sharpshooters pin down the pass from the western watch ruin.

cast.name: Pell the Underwritten
cast.description: Navigating the 2.5D elevation contours, using plateau sightlines and boulder cover to outflank Vane's rearguard.

cast.name: Factor Vane of House Kestrel
cast.description: Urging his cryo-servitors up the high eastern saddle toward the sky cathedral before sunset.

cast.name: Surveyor-Senior Vellum
cast.description: Tracking the consignment's cryogenic trail across the permafrost with his pocket brass astrolabe.

primitives.name: Smuggled Hexagonal Stasis Coffin
primitives.description: Borosilicate glass hull leaking superfluid vapor across the granite pass. Contains the slumbering Frost Monarch.

primitives.name: Pass Waystation Iron Brazier
primitives.description: Cast-iron coal basket providing sightline illumination and thermal shelter against sub-zero mountain winds.

primitives.name: Pass Boundary Marker Signpost
primitives.description: Dual wooden signpost marking the jurisdiction divide between the Scaffolded Kingdom and the Grey Wind.
